name: user-config
body: The user config: kalide's per-user settings file under the operating system's user config directory — a flat key-to-string-value map over the recognised keys. It is shared by every deck and every working directory; kalide creates or updates it on `kalide config set`, reads it on `kalide config get|list` and when resolving the default template directory for `kalide init`. Its recognised key set is `default-template-dir` (domain.value.default-template-dir); a key outside the set is refused by `kalide config` as a usage error. Local filesystem only.
